scale_cues: The white plate is about 26 cm across and used as the main scale reference. Almonds are about 1.5 to 2 cm long. Cherries are about 2 to 2.5 cm in diameter. The apple spans roughly 10 cm, about 40% of the plate width, and sits beside the cherry cluster.
assumptions: Almond count is roughly 60 to 70 pieces at about 1.1 g each, so about 65 g total.
Cherry count is roughly 22 to 26 pieces at about 7 g each, so about 175 g total.
The fruit is an apple, though a pear is possible given its rounded shape and green-yellow color.
No sauces, dressings, oil, or drinks are visible.
Apple weight includes skin and core, since both are edible or eaten in typical logging.
